newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal aims to privatise TAP '98 -paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal aims to privatise TAP '98 -paper.

text.p: The Portuguese government aims to privatise state airline TAP-Air Portugal in 1998, Diario Economico newspaper reported on Wednesday.

It quoted Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos as saying: "TAP will be one of the companies that, due to the recent significant improvement in its results, we are thinking about including in the privatisation programme for 1998/99."
He declined to comment on how much of TAP would be sold, but the paper reported without giving its sources that the government was considering selling a 49 percent stake.
The paper reported that Planning and Public Works Minister Joao Cravinho had told the Finance Ministry that 1998 was the ideal timing for the sell-off.
Planning and Finance Ministry officials were not immediately available.
